Most materials are websites you can read right away. The sources are on GitHub, so
you can copy and adapt them for your own course.

## Linear Algebra and Numerical Methods

A Quarto book on linear algebra with numerical methods in Python.

[Open the book](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/linalg-project/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/linalg-project){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Python Crash Course

A short introduction to Python for mathematics students, made at Lund University and
based on Jan-Fredrik Olsen's lecture notes *"Don't panic"*.

[Open the course](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/crashcourse_python/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/crashcourse_python){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## Quarto Tutorial

How to write your own interactive teaching material with Quarto: websites, exercise
sheets, books and Python that runs in the browser. Three levels (example page,
getting started, tips & tricks) in five languages (German, English, Swedish,
Norwegian, Danish).

[Open the tutorial](https://erasmus-ctm.github.io/Quarto-Tutorial/en/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/Quarto-Tutorial){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

## RUB tutorials

Interactive tutorials from Ruhr-Universität Bochum for first-semester students. Python runs in the
browser, exercises are checked automatically, and there is optional AI feedback. All are
available in German and English. For now the complete sources are on GitHub (the
rendered websites are in the `docs/` folder of each tutorial); standalone websites will follow.

| Tutorial | Content |
|---|---|
| [Kurvendiskussion](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/thematicProjects/tree/main/RUBTutorials/Kurvendiskussion) (curve sketching) | Domain and range, symmetry and zeros, asymptotes, derivatives, monotonicity, extrema, curvature, drawing graphs |
| [Matrizen](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/thematicProjects/tree/main/RUBTutorials/Matrizen) (matrices and vectors) | Linear algebra with NumPy: vectors, matrix operations, transformations, linear systems, eigenvalues |
| [Statistik](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/thematicProjects/tree/main/RUBTutorials/Statistik) (statistics) | Descriptive statistics, estimation, significance and p-values |

: {.sm}
